meta.notes: Automatically assembled controlled-pilot snapshot from the Morganton weather workflow. Defaults to REVIEWED and never self-designates OPERATIONAL. Daily Downburst Model supplies the reviewed Downburst Index/SPC handoff; NWS Digital Forecast/grid data supply wind, QPF, temperature, snow and ice; MORG ECONet supplies antecedent rainfall and permitted derived soil context; a QC-validated automated vegetation-moisture screening result (or separately validated, same-day qualitative briefing when supplied) is kept separate from calculated forecast risk; Load Stress remains manual.

vegetation_vulnerability.basis: Provisional antecedent-moisture screen (pilot-moisture-screen-v1): 24h rainfall 0.00 in; 72h 0.06 in; 168h 0.25 in. 10/20-cm 24h changes +0.000/+0.000 m3/m3; within-week relative ranks 11.0/11.0. Trigger: no elevated rainfall-plus-wetting screening signal. Within-week ranks are NOT climatological soil-saturation percentiles. A Normal screen does not certify root stability or rule out localized saturated ground, erosion, or hazardous trees. MORG observations are now STALE; this is the last known same-day screen, not an updated live assessment.
vegetation_vulnerability.methodology: Rule-based provisional antecedent moisture screening; not a calibrated tree-failure probability or full tree-failure composite

nws_nbm.notes: Schema source bucket retained for backward compatibility. Actual source is NWS Digital Forecast / NDFD and api.weather.gov grid data for Morganton. Source-aligned 24-hour QPF window 2026-11-25T16:00:00-05:00 through 2026-11-26T16:00:00-05:00, 24 consecutive NWS one-hour QPF slots, no minute-level prorating. Wind gust uses the maximum NWS grid windGust overlapping the same 24-hour window. Minimum temperature uses NWS hourly grid temperature through 72 hours. Snow and ice use NWS grid accumulation intervals conservatively; non-zero partial boundary intervals are unavailable rather than prorated. The 72-hour timeline uses eight 3-hour intervals followed by eight 6-hour intervals. Interval QPF sums consecutive NWS hourly slots; next-24-hour QPF is retained separately for tree-moisture vulnerability.
